Name: Big Chests Look Like Normal Chests
Author: addioangel
Description:
Big chests now look like normal chests.
Currently works for both Vanilla big chests along with Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn big chests.
If there's any recolor mod you'd like compatibility for, feel free to request it!

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]1- Download either the Vanilla or VPR file + any external mods they may require[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]2- Extract the chosen file to your mods folder[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]3- Finished![/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]This is a Content Patcher mod, it will not work without Content Patcher.[/color]
